messages.author: jens.wouters
messages.text: Heads-up: PC 200 clients get the end-of-year premium in a separate payroll run on 20 December this year, not with the regular December payroll.

messages.text: Is that official? The procedure says the end-of-year premium goes with the December payroll, cutoff 15 December.

messages.text: Agreed with Sofie in a call. The procedure document is not updated yet.

messages.text: Quick check: double holiday pay is 85%, right?

messages.author: lotte.devos
messages.text: That is probably the old holiday pay version, not sure which one is current.

messages.text: Who owns the NL sick leave doc? It has not been touched since 2024.

messages.text: Nordlicht Software HR called: their home-working allowance goes up to EUR 175 per month from 1 October. The client file is not updated yet.
